elements.requirement: Section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977 is identified as providing for the offence of conspiracy.
elements.quote: which provides for the offence of conspiracy

elements.requirement: An offence must be disregarded for the purposes of section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977 where acts in relation to that offence are to be done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute pursuant to an agreement mentioned in that subsection, provided the offence is a summary offence not punishable with imprisonment.
elements.quote: the offence shall be disregarded for the purposes of that subsection if it is a summary offence which is not punishable with imprisonment

elements.requirement: Section 242 of the Trade Union and Labour Relations (Consolidation) Act 1992 extends to England and Wales only.
elements.quote: extends to England and Wales only
